relationships.subject: abobotulinumtoxinA
relationships.evidence_quote: In comparison to vehicle-treated controls, aboBoNT-A-treated animals showed a marked decrease in GFAP immunostaining which occurred diffusely and bilaterally

relationships.subject: abobotulinumtoxinA
relationships.evidence_quote: In comparison to vehicle-treated controls, aboBoNT-A-treated animals showed a moderate decrease in Iba1 immunolabelling which occurred diffusely and bilaterally

relationships.subject: abobotulinumtoxinA
relationships.evidence_quote: The intensity of CGRP immunolabelling was similar in saline- and aboBoNT-A-treated animals

key_findings: Intraoperative aboBoNT-A dose-dependently reversed post-surgical allodynia and reduced distress behaviors in pigs, unlike liposomal bupivacaine
Cleaved SNAP25 was found in ipsilateral dorsal horn but not skin or DRG; GFAP and Iba1 were reduced in spinal cord with no change in CGRP or SP
